title: The Starlit Search for Certainty
intro: Picture standing beneath a vast night sky, watching bright lights rise and then fade while searching for what truly deserves devotion. Around you, silent carved images receive praise and offerings, yet clear reason questions their power. A fearless voice is about to challenge inherited tradition and point toward the Creator of the heavens and the earth.
clues: I looked to the stars, the moon, and the sun, and I reasoned they could not be my Lord because they set and disappear.
I openly disavowed what my people worshipped besides Allah and called them to worship the Creator alone.
I debated a boastful ruler who claimed to give life and death, and I answered by mentioning Allah bringing the sun from the east.
I struck the idols and shattered them, leaving only the largest among them so the people might return to it.
I was seized and condemned by my people, who said to build a structure and cast me into the blazing fire.
I was saved when Allah commanded the fire to be coolness and safety for me.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham)
Prophet Yahya (John)
Prophet Al-Yasa (Elisha)
The Samiri
Namrud (Nimrod)

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Confronted idol worship and debated the meaning of celestial bodies
Was swallowed by a great fish after departing in anger
Led followers through a sea parted by Allah
Was raised alive to the heavens without tasting death
Slept in a cave with companions for many years
trial.answer: Confronted idol worship and debated the meaning of celestial bodies

location.label: Key Element
options: A blazing fire made cool and safe by Allah
The ark that carried believers through the flood
The staff that became a serpent
The table spread from heaven
The she-camel sent as a sign
location.answer: A blazing fire made cool and safe by Allah

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Protected from fire and granted righteous descendants
Drowned with deniers in a great flood
Transformed for violating the Sabbath
Destroyed by birds carrying stones of clay
Swallowed by the earth with treasures
outcome.answer: Protected from fire and granted righteous descendants

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُوقِنِينَ
verse: And thus did We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith]. (6:75)
